units: <cite ref="Chullin 36a:12">Ḥull. 36ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 20a:6">Pes. 20ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 102b:8">Men. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ של מנחות</he> (Ms. M. every here <he>צריר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. II. notes) the dry portion of meal offerings (not permeated with oil).

<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 1:8">Eduy. I, 8</cite> <he>יאכל צ׳</he> (early eds. <he>צריר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9) it must be eaten dry (coarsely pounded without being moistened); <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:4">Maas. Sh. II, 4</cite>.
